messages:
maria: heads-up — staging rollout flaked twice this morning. looks like GH actions + Atlantis apply + ArgoCD reconcile are stepping on each other. saw 409s from the argocd webhook and resources getting reconciled to older manifests.
jon: yep saw that too. same time window as two GH actions runs overlapping for different PRs that touched the same k8s apps.
maria: proposed quick fix: serialize per-branch GH Actions runs so we don't run multiple workflows for the same PR/branch.
jon: simple config that helps:
```yaml
concurrency:
  group: \"infra-${{ github.ref }}\"
  cancel-in-progress: false
```
sam: that prevents same-branch races, but cross-PR ordering still possible. Atlantis apply can run across PRs and both push manifests that ArgoCD picks up.
kelly: terraform state uses dynamodb lock so infra state is safe, but k8s app reconciliation is a different surface. ArgoCD doesn't provide a global lock for apps.
maria: we could add an atlantis post-apply step that waits until ArgoCD reports the affected app healthy before finishing the apply — that would at least make the lifecycle sequential per-apply.
jon: example idea for atlantis postapply (bash):
```bash
# wait-for-argocd.sh
app=$1
timeout=${2:-300}
until ./argocd wait app "$app" --health --timeout $timeout; do
  echo "waiting for $app"
  sleep 5
done
```
deploy-bot: Atlantis apply started for plan 482 by @jon :rocket:
maria: also discovered GH Actions runner repo concurrency was misconfigured earlier this week, so a few long-running workflows piled up and spawned new runs — worth fixing repository settings too.
sam: alternative: keep PR-level applies fast but have a final serialized "infra-sync" job that runs only on merge to main. that final job would do the canonical ArgoCD sync and any post-merge reconciliations.
kelly: I like the final-sync idea. reduces PR friction and ensures canonical ordering on main. we should also add exponential retry for argocd webhook 409s — those look transient.
jon: agreed. here's a combined approach:
- add GH Actions concurrency to prevent duplicate branch runs
- implement atlantis postapply wait-for-argocd hook for PR-level safety
- add final infra-sync job on merge to main for canonical ordering
- add retry/backoff on argocd webhook client side

maria: action items and owners:
- add concurrency config to GH Actions (jon) — will open PR today
- add atlantis postapply wait script (sam) — will prototype tomorrow
- implement final infra-sync on merge (maria) — planning for next sprint
- add retry/backoff to argocd webhook client (kelly) — will draft small lib change

jon: I'll also check repo-level runner settings and disable accidental parallel allowances.
maria: cool — ping me when PR is up, i'll review fast. @jon :eyes:
sam: will post the initial wait script here once I have it, will include logs showing behavior.
kelly: I'll update the infra runbook (deploy ordering section) and add notes about these patterns.
maria: thanks all, this should reduce the flakiness. i'll follow up in the morning with a quick status update :partyparrot:
deploy-bot: Atlantis apply finished for plan 482 :white_check_mark:
